source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to the reactions of halogenoalkanes (PDF 78-79).

blocks.text: C-X bond polar hai kyunke carbon aur halogen ki electronegativity mukhtalif hai. C-X ka carbon electrophilic markaz hai jis par nucleophile hamla kar sakta hai; ya parosi carbon ke hydrogen par base hamla kar sakta hai. Yeh do imkanat halogenoalkanes ke reactions ki do qismein dete hain.

items: Nucleophilic substitution (SN): halogen ki jagah koi aur atom ya group aata; halide ion leaving group hai.
Elimination (E): halogenoalkane se HX nikal kar alkene banta.

blocks.alt: Nu- se delta+ carbon ki taraf mura teer (curly arrow), aur C-X bond se X ki taraf mura teer. Teer ke baad Nu-C (baqi teen bonds ab doosri taraf) + X-. Labels: hamla karne wala nucleophile (Attacking Nucleophile), substrate molecule, substituted product, leaving group.
blocks.caption: Nucleophilic substitution reaction (kitab ke PDF safha 79 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Substrate ke do jure carbons, aik par H aur agle par X (dono dashed dabbe mein), se alkene C=C + HX. Labels: Substrate Molecule, Alkene, Hydrogen Halide.
blocks.caption: Elimination reaction (kitab ke PDF safha 79 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Halogenoalkanes ke reactions ki do qismein kya hain, aur har aik mein molecule par kaun hamla karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Nucleophilic substitution, jis mein nucleophile delta+ carbon par hamla karta; elimination, jis mein base parosi carbon ke hydrogen par hamla karta.

items: Do reactions: nucleophilic substitution (SN) aur elimination (E).
